svg.title: Identity the government already trusts
svg.desc: Integrated Zalopay with VNeID, Vietnam's national digital ID, so users verify once instead of re-uploading ID papers. I owned sign-up success, added chip-card (NFC) checks and let people resume where they stopped. Identity · sign-up success x4.

ID papers. I owned sign-up success, added chip-card (NFC) checks and let people resume where they stopped.
